name: print-social-risk-reduction-post-with-lime-radar-sweep-over-avatar-grid
title: 'Risk Reduction & Predictability' post with a lime radar sweep over a grid of avatar tiles
whatItIs: A portrait near-black post with a lime X logo, a lime circle with a black 'G' at the centre of concentric radar rings with a green sweep beam, over a faded 3x3 grid of avatar placeholder tiles, and a white title with grey body copy ('Invisible to noise. Visible in results.').
whatItMeans: Precise and watchful; the radar metaphor sells monitoring and control.
techniques: Use a radar sweep as a monitoring metaphor.
Fade a grid of tiles behind the focal ring.
Glow one neon colour on black.
Keep copy short and at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: A rotating beam wedge over concentric circles.
